note: order-acceptance-contract-risks: every order now carries an Accept line (what counts as passed, in his words) that the inspector reads one by one; a Contract line for a hand-off between workers (what is handed over and its shape); and one risk page, muster/RISKS.md (owner, what would go wrong, what closes it), kept by the manager. The end-of-turn check refuses a To/Job order with no filled Accept line, and an empty Contract line; a Contract line may be left out when nothing is handed over
